{{Quote|He was arrested trying to bribe General Garza. What business had you with him?|[[Hreda]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Curao''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] associate of [[Rogun Matt'rik|Rogun the Butcher]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3640 BBY]] Rogun sent the [[Voidhound]] to meet Curao on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] to try and get to [[Darmas Pollaran]] and [[Bevera Dodonna]]. However, before the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] could reach him, Curao foolishly attempted to bribe [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Elin Garza]] and was promptly arrested, forcing the Voidhound to look for other allies on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].
